evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-10-15, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Cal, miss ya!"): told him it's been "a crazy rollercoaster week" — a competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal Dave's shop had been trying to secure for months — and that he felt "kinda bummed out" and questioned whether his hard work is a waste ("I put in so much effort at work, but it feels like nothing. Am I wasting my time?") (details in ## Car maintenance shop); Calvin: "Hey Dave, sorry to hear that. It can be discouraging when you feel like your hard work goes unnoticed. But don't give up, keep pushing and believe in yourself. The payoff will be worth it."; Dave: "Calvin, thanks for the encouragement. It can be tough when you feel like your efforts are going unseen. I gotta have faith and patience. I'm sure it's only a matter of time till things work out." and asked how Calvin stays motivated when faced with setbacks; Calvin: "When setbacks come my way, I remind myself why I'm passionate about my goals. I rely on helpful people around me and take a break to recharge with my favorite activities. That always helps me get back to feeling motivated." (Calvin's motivation details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "That's a great approach, Cal! Reminding yourself of the passion for the goals and getting help from others is really important. Taking a break and having fun sounds so refreshing." and then told Calvin he just got back from a music festival — "it was amazing! The energy, the music, the crowd - sooo good. I felt so alive!" (details in ## Music); Calvin: "Wow Dave, sounds awesome! Music festivals bring so much joy and the energy of the crowd can be amazing." and asked for photos from the festival — "I'd love to check them out and join in on the fun."; Dave shared a photo of the main stage (a photo of a stage with a crowd of people watching a band) — "The main stage was unreal. The headliner was so good and the vibe was unreal!"; Calvin: "Wow, that looks awesome! The crowd looks really excited and the stage is incredible. Who was the headliner?" — Dave had not answered that question as the chat ended; the conversation then continued (below) and Dave identified The Fireworks as the headliner [S23T1][S23T2][S23T3][S23T4][S23T5][S23T6][S23T7][S23T8].
- The 2023-10-15 conversation continued: Dave said The Fireworks headlined the festival (answering Calvin's question); Calvin: "Wow, I heard great things about The Fireworks! Performing with Frank Ocean recently has been really cool. Seeing them perform live must've been awesome - I bet the energy was electric. That's why I love my job so much - connecting with the crowd." [S23T9][S23T10]. Dave: "The crowd had such a buzz. Music brings people together in such an amazing way, and it's just like when I'm fixing up things. I love the feeling of taking something broken and making it whole again. That's why I keep doing what I do." (echoes his sense of purpose from fixing things — details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) Calvin: "Music and repairing things are so fulfilling and satisfying. Seeing something go from broken to whole is incredible. You're making a difference too - it's amazing. Keep it up, friend." [S23T11][S23T12]. Dave thanked Calvin — his support "really helps," it's "great to have a friend who believes in me," and he'll "keep pushing" [S23T13]; Calvin: "I believe in you, Dave. Keep pushing and never forget how awesome you are." [S23T14]; Dave: "Your support means a lot. I'm gonna keep going and not forget my value!" [S23T15]; Calvin closed urging Dave to "keep going for those dreams. You got this!", then announced he got a new Ferrari "last week" (~2023-10-09/15), sharing a photo of it (a black sports car parked in front of a building) — "Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood." (Calvin's Ferrari details in the New luxury car section of /memories/calvin.md) [S23T16]. The 2023-10-15 conversation then closed: Dave thanked Calvin for the kind words and encouragement ("Your positivity is contagious"), congratulated him on the new Ferrari — "that's incredible! Must be one amazing ride" — and said he was "all in for those thrilling journeys," asking Calvin to "share a pic of your new beauty whenever you're ready"; Calvin: "The Ferrari is indeed a showstopper. I'll be sure to share a pic soon." — the two are now to keep sharing "thrilling rides and positive vibes," and the chat closed with "Take care, and looking forward to catching up soon!" [S23T17][S23T18].

- On 2023-10-25, caught up with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! Long time no talk!"): Calvin told him he had a great time the day before (2023-10-24), visiting some sights in Boston with a high school friend — "It was really fun and eye-opening"; Dave: "Sounds like you had a blast in Boston - so much to do there!" and mentioned one of his favorites there that's "great for chilling and admiring nature" (his Boston parks — details in ## Boston and ## Parks); Calvin: "I had a wonderful experience during my time in Boston. It had awesome architecture and a really cool history. I followed your advice and went there, it was so peaceful." [S26T1][S26T2][S26T3]. Dave then told Calvin he recently attended a conference in Detroit — "it was so cool, I learned a lot" (details in the Car workshops in San Francisco section of this file); Calvin: "Good to hear that you've learned a lot of new things at the conference in Detroit!" [S26T2][S26T3]. The chat then turned to Dave's latest car project — he shared a photo (a group of people washing a car in a garage) and said working on this "takes me out of my head and calms me down" (details in ## Classic cars and ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); Calvin: "Dave, that car looks awesome! What got you into engineering cars? I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models." (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S26T4][S26T5]. Dave answered that cars have "always been my thing": his dad took him to his first car show when he was 10, he was "wow-ed" and "hooked" and wanted to learn more — now he's an automotive engineer, and it's "crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts" (a complementary origin story to the 2023-10-23 account in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); Calvin: "That's awesome, Dave! So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music." [S26T6][S26T7]. Calvin then shared a photo of himself performing in a nightclub (a DJ at a DJ table) with someone he admires — "Check this out - a pic of me performing with someone I admire! So amazing!" (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing! You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?" [S26T7][S26T8]. Calvin: being "up there with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and the energy and the crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose" (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S26T9]. Dave: "That's great, Calvin. We both have discovered something that brings us fulfillment. It's a fortunate thing for us." [S26T10]. Calvin: it's awesome to find something that makes them happy — fulfilling and motivating too — and he's glad they're "on this journey together" and curious to see what happens next [S26T11]. Dave: "Me too, Calvin! Let's see where it takes us. We can keep inspiring each other!" [S26T12]. Calvin: let's "keep inspiring each other to be our best selves" and urges Dave to "keep going for your passion, buddy" [S26T13]; Dave: "Thanks, Calvin! Same to you! Keep pursuing your passion and keep dreaming. We got this!" [S26T14]; the chat closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying they'll "keep pushing for our goals" — "Catch you later, see ya!" — and Dave: "Got to go, see you soon!" [S26T15].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-05-31, said working on cars is "definitely therapeutic" and that it is not difficult for him to help neighbors with their cars [S7T4].
- Passionate about fixing up things in general: "more than just a hobby" — it gives him a sense of achievement and purpose [S7T6].
- Gets "a real buzz" transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly — "like giving it a second chance" [S7T6].
- Giving something a new life "makes [him] feel powerful and happy — like [he] really achieved something"; he agreed with Calvin that they both "take something and make it look amazing" [S7T7][S7T8].
- On 2023-08-03, said fixing cars is like therapy for him; growing up he worked on cars with his dad, and refurbishing them gives him a sense of fulfillment [S12T2].
- On 2023-09-02, when telling Calvin he's been tied up with car stuff, said fixing stuff up and seeing it turn out better is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", and that fixing someone's car makes him feel like he's "making a difference"; he's made "proud" to see the relief on someone's face when their car is fixed (echoing his long-stated sense of purpose from fixing things, see above) [S17T3][S17T5].
- Has fond memories of working on cars with his dad as a kid: they spent one summer restoring an old car — "It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying" [S12T4].
- Shared a photo from that time: a man and a child (Dave and his dad) posing for a picture — "a wonderful experience" [S12T6].
- On 2023-09-15, told Calvin (answering whether it's satisfying to see his hard work pay off, on the restoration finished that day — context in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) that "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9].
- On 2023-10-04, said he loves being able to transform something old and beat-up into something beautiful, and that it's the small successes that make him feel proud and fulfilled (said to Calvin right after Calvin praised his grease-stained hands — "Those hands show you worked hard. You put in lots of effort. You should definitely be proud!" — context in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) [S21T10].
- On 2023-10-08, when telling Calvin about his car show and restored/modified car (details in ## Classic cars), said working on cars "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — it's "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress"; as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage, tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" (echoing his childhood memories of working on cars with his dad, see above); now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" [S22T5].
- On 2023-10-08, said doing what he loves has been "my goal since I was a kid" and it's awesome that he's able to do it; restoring things can be tough but "the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great"; Calvin responded that bringing broken things back to life is "so satisfying," that working on cars "can be a real escape from reality" (he understands the feeling), and that "doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal," adding "Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." [S22T5][S22T6][S22T7].
